decision.reason: [ev-baf37887295d] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that string array elements "were not being parsed correctly in JSON processing" and links to PR 11921, which is not shown. It does not name the component (for example, the LogQL json parser or another JSON stage), what the incorrect output was, or what the corrected output is. Without that, neither applicability (which queries or pipelines use this JSON processing) nor consequence (what an exposed environment sees if it does nothing) can be written. The other Bug Fixes items in the same section (e.g. [ev-d6a898e57d04]) are separate changes and add nothing about this one, so the PR or a matching upgrade-guide section is needed.
